Switches show actual device settings. Tap Refresh to retry failed reads. Heart rate retains the 10-minute demo interval. Skin temperature and respiratory rate send 60 for on and 0 for off; those values are not interpreted as minutes. Failed saves restore the previous display; no rollback command is sent.

When this is on, the watch screen lights up when you raise your wrist and turn it toward yourself. This page reads the switch with getFlipLightUpEnable and writes it with setFlipLightUpEnable. Tap Refresh to retry a failed read. A failed save restores the display only; no rollback command is sent.

Fixed sample health inputs, real AI SDK requests. DeviceId defaults to the connected device MAC, lowercase without separators; channel ID and AppKey use the HaWoFit NoScreen defaults. OmniAgent initializes on page entry, then enables the corresponding insight, body status or sleep request button. Reinitialize after editing configuration or to retry a failure. Health analysis retains its existing AFlash initialization on click. Sleep uses 24-hour time and a rolling 7/30-day range. Results are displayed only, not saved or sent to the watch.

Entry: com.huawo.ai.AiCenter\nSupports AI watchface, Q&A, meeting, health analysis, and related BLE + cloud flows.

Put in app/libs: ai-*.aar, BluetoothSDK-*.aar, qjs-watchface-*.aar, QW_release_*.aar, BmpConvert_*.aar, jl_pack_resource_*.aar.\nGradle: implementation fileTree(dir: \'libs\', include: [\'*.aar\'])\nAlso need okhttp / gson / lifecycle-process and matching Sifli AARs.

Watch-mic path: no phone RECORD_AUDIO.\nPhone mic / Watch-via-SCO: request RECORD_AUDIO (API 33+ POST_NOTIFICATIONS; API 34+ FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE), then AiCenter.startRecordService().\nAlso need INTERNET and BLE (Android 12+: BLUETOOTH_SCAN / CONNECT).

1) Application: AiCenter.setApplication(app)
2) Connect watch via BluetoothSDK
3) init(ctx, false) → setAiEvent → setCallback → setRecordFromDevice(…) → startWorking
4) setDeviceInfo(AiDeviceInfo) — required (missing → 80051)
5) Exit: stopWorking() / destroy()
Sync foreground: setAppInForeground(true/false)
setRecordFromDevice: true = watch mic (do not call startRecordService()); false = app mic (+ startRecordService()).
Set mac, type, id (AFlash DeviceId, not MAC), width/height/corner, thumbnail size, locale.\nPanel size must match the real watch. Call again after reconnect or locale/size change.
